empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a named block of review rules that your agents load into their prompt. Write one, or import a Markdown file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit, preview or version it.

unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.body: Your edits to {name} are not saved. Leave and discard them?

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It is the skill's file name and the heading of its prompt block.
fields.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface: the model reads it to know what the skill is for. Phrase it as a directive — 'Flag …', 'Reject …', 'Prefer …'.
fields.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule

Describe what the reviewer should look for…

config.title: Configuration
config.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? It is detached from {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the skill so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.
versions.restoreDisabled: Save or discard your edits first
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This creates v{next} with the content of v{version}. History is kept.

future.context: Project context for skills arrives in M5
future.evals: Skill eval cases arrive in M6
future.stats: Skill usage stats arrive in M7

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a directive description and a Markdown body, loaded into every agent that enables it.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitlePick: Step 1 of 2 — pick a .md file or a .zip skill archive.
import.subtitlePreview: Step 2 of 2 — read the skill and edit it before you save.
import.fileHint: Only Markdown is read. Scripts and other files in an archive are listed and ignored.
import.badType: Only .md and .zip files can be imported.
import.readError: Could not read {name}. Pick the file again.
import.trustWarning: This skill's text goes into your agents' prompts as instructions. Read it before you save: a skill from someone else is someone else's instructions to your reviewer.
